answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock a scarce, transferable token before it may post bids, with the lock held through settlement. A registry caps how much voting or work weight one address gains from splitting its balance, so a thousand fresh identities do not multiply influence. The mechanism does not prove who is human; it makes each added identity consume capital and remain exposed to slashing for fraud. An attacker pays the opportunity cost of immobilized tokens and risks losing them, whether launching at dawn, composing a sonnet, or crossing a dune.
